ha-app-node.title: HA: application node failure
ha-app-node.description: One of two site A application nodes is killed. The load balancer should route around it with no human action.

ha-db-primary.title: HA: primary database failure
ha-db-primary.description: The primary database is killed. The standby is promoted after an incident declaration; apps reconnect via a multi-host connection string.

dr-site-a-loss.title: DR: loss of primary site
dr-site-a-loss.description: All of site A (both app nodes and the primary database) is lost at once. Site B's replica is promoted and its warm standby app takes traffic.

cyber-logical-corruption.title: Cyber: destructive logical corruption
cyber-logical-corruption.description: The orders table is destroyed on the primary, and replication faithfully copies the damage to site B. Recovery requires containment, choosing a clean restore point, and restoring from the backup vault.
